reviewContext.userProblem: riela instance reload/run/cancel/executions and riela environment status/reload only work over HTTP to the App web server; with the web server disabled they fail.
requiredOutcomes: No --server: local mode (owner-only Unix socket for live ops, local SQLite reads, locked local reload when no App runs); --server <url>: unchanged HTTP.
One shared RielaAppInstanceControlService used by the App HTTP handlers and the socket channel, HTTP status/body byte-identical.
App holds run/app.lock whenever profile state is in memory or writable; deferred startup with no unlocked fallback; socket unlinked/bound only under the lock.
Channel: 0700 run dir, 0600 socket, getpeereid same-uid, length-prefixed JSON, 576 KiB request / 1 MiB response, 5 s read deadline, 30 s client timeout, idempotent request ids.
No App: live commands return app_not_running; executions and local reload still work.
No secrets on disk, in logs or in responses; environment status names/readiness only.
Docs describe modes, precedence, channel and codes.
nonGoals: No env var for mode selection; no new path options; no in-process run flag.
No change to HTTP router/guards, other /actions, GraphQL, web server controller.
Do not run/restart/reconfigure the installed RielaApp; never touch ~/.riela/rielaapp or ~/Library/Application Support in tests.
constraints: Work only in /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/serverless-control on branch feat/serverless-app-control; no worktrees, branches or concurrent git operations.
Tests use /tmp/rac-<8hex> app roots and temp HOME only.

Existing tests InstanceAppCommandsTests, InstanceAppCancelCommandTests, RielaAppInstanceReload*/Cancel*/ExecutionsProjection tests stay unmodified; RuntimeEnvironmentChannelTests only gains --server on environment-client invocations.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Wave 1 pins contract types (sac-01), owner lock/startup (sac-02), shared source discovery + executions projection (sac-03) and docs (sac-09) with disjoint new files.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Wave 2/3 plans compile against fixed shapes without editing shared files.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: RielaAppInstanceReloadResponse.revision becomes Int?; RielaAppInstanceReloadPorts gains liveRevision() with a default returning revision(); only local ports return nil.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Local reload omits revision without changing the App's ports or HTTP output.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: RielaAppAPIClient.resolveEndpoint keeps its nil-server branch unchanged, but command flow never calls it without --server.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps testDiscoveryIsReadOnlyAndValidatesServer unchanged (acceptance: existing HTTP client tests unchanged) while removing implicit HTTP from command flow.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Local reload when no App runs goes through RielaAppInstanceControlService with RielaAppLocalControlPorts while holding app.lock.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Same validation, commit and error rendering as the App; lock gives exclusion per the accepted design.

intentionalTradeoffs: Running-App reload stays inside the App (channel instance.reload) so validate -> admission close -> commit -> respawn stays one serialized sequence (design §3.2).
instance run/cancel and environment status/reload return app_not_running without an App; no in-process run flag because it would bypass App credentials and overlap/admission control (design §3.9).
The App never runs unlocked: a stopped CLI holding app.lock keeps the App waiting; normal holds are bounded by the 30 s pre-commit cap plus one commit (design §6).
Default behaviour change: commands without --server no longer fall back to implicit HTTP; callers must add --server (design §3.1, §4).
Channel may answer between bind and phaseB with a transient 404/422 (step5 review finding, low, accepted).
Wave-parallel per-plan package-wide builds share .build; mitigated by record-and-rerun and the serial integration gate (step5 review finding, low, accepted).
supportedEdgeCases: No App running: instance executions and instance reload work locally (reload under app.lock, no respawn, revision omitted); live commands return app_not_running.
App holds lock but socket not answering: app_channel_unavailable.
Insecure run dir or socket ownership/permissions: app_channel_insecure; socket path over 103 bytes: app_channel_path_too_long.

Oversized request: 413 request_too_large without reading body; malformed envelope: 400 invalid_request; same request id with different digest: 409 request_id_conflict; idempotency cache full: 503 channel_busy; no response in 30 s: app_channel_timeout; malformed/oversized response: app_channel_protocol_error.
instance run --wait polling falls back to local execution detail read when launch.status returns 404.
Startup racing a local reload: phaseB loads the relinked definition and a later save preserves it.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: An App older than this change (no lock, no socket) running alongside local reload; documented one-time upgrade only, --server keeps working (design §4).
Instances whose workflow source only the running App can discover: local executions/reload report invalid_workflow_source; use --server (design §6).
In-process instance run from the CLI without an App (design §3.9, user-qa).
Environment variable based mode selection and new app-root/project-dir path options (design §3.1).

acceptanceCriteria: RielaAppControlOperation, RielaAppControlResult, RielaAppControlBootstrap, RielaAppControlConflict, RielaAppEnvironmentReloadOutcome, RielaAppConfiguredRunInput, RielaAppInstanceControlPorts, RielaAppControlLimits, RielaAppControlErrorCode, request/response envelopes and RielaAppControlEnvelopeError exist with the plan's exact signatures.
Strict envelope decode enforces the exact 8-key set, lowercase UUID requestId, per-operation null rules and profile/identity byte limits; digest excludes requestId.
RielaAppControlContractTests pass.
RielaAppRunDirectory validates run/ (dir, not symlink, owner euid, mode&077==0) and socket file (socket, owner, mode&177==0).
RielaAppOwnerLock.tryAcquire/acquireBlocking use flock on run/app.lock (0600); in-process second tryAcquire returns nil until release.
RielaAppOwnerStartup never unlinks/binds the socket or runs phaseB before lock acquisition; insecure run/ calls failed and creates no lock.
Startup-versus-local-reload regression proves phaseB loads relink B and a later save preserves B; live owner's socket stand-in is untouched while the lock is held; tests pass 3 consecutive runs.
